assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent dizziness consistent with a history of atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
Diagnosis code I48.91 is associated with atrial fibrillation.
Diagnosis code I49.5 is associated with sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a concurrent diagnosis of mitral valve insufficiency.

The purpose of the order is to correlate symptomatic episodes with arrhythmic events and assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
